title: Evaluation of a Product Character
statement: For every positive integer $m$, every natural number $n$, and functions $\alpha,x:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\mathbb Z/m\mathbb Z$, the product character indexed by $\alpha$, evaluated at $x$, equals $\prod_{i=0}^{n-1}\chi_{\alpha(i)}(x(i))$, where $\chi_j$ denotes the cyclic character indexed by $j$.
